sources.title: Model Card Explorer
sources.snippet: Our platform extracts structured evaluation data from each card and enables cross-lab and cross-generation comparisons. By tracking what AI companies disclose about their models' capabilities, limitations, and safety evaluations, we make it easier for researchers, policymakers, and the public to understand the state of AI governance.
